content.text:
Budget (estimates, not sourced): costs of about $100–150 (ingredients, packaging, labels, signs, a $50 cash float); target income of $250–400 from 150+ items at $1–3 each.

Roles: a coordinator to lead; bakers to donate labelled items; two cashiers; 2–3 for setup and cleanup; one publicity lead for flyers and announcements.

Main risks:
- Allergens: label every item, including nuts and dairy.
- Food safety: avoid fillings needing refrigeration; keep items covered.
- Weather: use an indoor or covered spot.
- Low turnout: promote early and sell at pickup times.
- Cash handling: use two people to count, and a lockbox.
- School permission: get head-teacher approval for food sales.

about.title: Supervisor: four workers, many turns, and a shared notebook
about.author: Agent Atlas Academy
about.description:
The supervisor chooses among four workers in turn and decides when the plan is done.

**What it teaches**

A supervisor sees everything, which is useful and expensive. The workers can leave notes in a shared notebook with a tool, so later workers know what earlier ones found.

**What to watch**

The order in which the workers are called, how the supervisor decides to stop, and which notes the workers write and read.

Read more: [Supervisor and workers](#/learn/supervisor-and-workers)
